$$5x + \frac{y}{12} = y$$

or, $$y - \frac{y}{12} = 5x$$

or, $$\frac{11}{12}y = 5x$$

$$\therefore y = \frac{60}{11}x$$

Now we put the possible values of $$x$$:

If $$x = 0$$, $$y = 0$$ minute i.e. $$12 : 00$$.

If $$x = 1$$, $$1 : 5\frac{5}{11}$$ minute.

If $$x = 2$$, $$2 : 10\frac{10}{11}$$ minute.

$$... ... ...$$

If $$x = 11$$, $$11 : 60$$ minute or, $$12 : 00$$.

As the first and last times are same, these two hands coincides 11 times and the times are: $$x : \frac{60}{11}x$$ minute.
**Work:** If in triangle $$ABC$$, $$\angle B = 2x^\circ$$, $$\angle C = x^\circ$$, $$\angle A = y^\circ$$ and $$\angle A = \angle B + \angle C$$, find the value of $$x$$ and $$y$$.
